run.executedVia: Playwright driving Lightning Experience. Every screen assertion is cross-checked against the ServiceNow record over cnit and the Salesforce record over the sf CLI. No case in this file writes to either platform.

case.title: Evidence and attestation are separate panels for separate people

steps.text: Read the row actions offered on RCAF0001039 — an Open and a Closed task.
Read the row actions offered on RCAF0001037 — an In Progress task.
Open the evidence panel on the In Progress task — the owner’s view.
Open the attest panel on the same task — the approver’s view.

records.label: Row actions offered, by task state

rows.heading: Attestation — CAFT0001046
rows.blocked_reason: Attach at least one evidence file before attesting. ServiceNow counts its own copy, not the Salesforce one.

observations: met_criteria is carried on the attestation form as a yes/no alongside the decision, not as its own button. Whether it belongs with the approver at all is HANDOFF open item 3 — decided, not settled.
Approve and Reject were read as controls and deliberately not clicked; either would close the task.
expected: Upload evidence opens cafEvidence alone, writable.
Attest opens cafEvidence read-only beside cafAttestation.
Row actions by state: Open → Start + Upload evidence; In Progress → Upload evidence + Attest; Closed → View evidence only.
There is no standalone "Criteria met" button.
actual: Owner view: upload control present = true; attestation panel alongside = false
Approver view: upload control present = false; attestation panel alongside = true
Attestation offers criteria options [] beside Approve/Reject.
case.verdictReason: Row actions match the specified set for every state observed; the two jobs open different panels; the approver’s copy of the evidence is read-only; no standalone Criteria met button.
